title: Seoul Korean BBQ: 13 spots for pork and beef
desc: A map of Korean BBQ restaurants across Seoul, split into pork (samgyeopsal, moksal, galbi) and beef or mixed grills, with price ranges where known.

items.title: Geumdwaeji Sikdang (금돼지식당)
items.memo: Premium pork, known for nunkkot moksal; about 25,000-45,000 won pp.

items.title: Yukjeon Sikdang (육전식당)
items.memo: Thick-cut pork belly and pork neck, about 25,000-40,000 won pp.

items.title: Mapo Jeong Daepo (정대포)
items.memo: Galmaegisal skirt meat grilled with an egg ring around the pan.

items.title: Cheongdonok (청돈옥)
items.memo: Aged pork including a tomahawk-style cut; English menu.

items.title: BBQ YUL Gangnam
items.memo: Aged pork grilled at the table; 30,000-50,000 won pp.

items.title: Sinmi Sikdang (신미식당)
items.memo: Chargrilled spicy pork ribs plus gamjatang in Apgujeong.

items.title: Mapo Sutbulgalbi (마포숯불갈비)
items.memo: Bone-in pork galbi in a large dining room, open very late.

items.title: Samgakjeong (삼각정)
items.memo: Mosori-sal and grilled pork skin; dinner-only hours.

items.title: Sammijung (삼미정)
items.memo: Samgyeopsal in Euljiro with indoor and outdoor alley seating.

items.title: Mongtan (몽탄)
items.memo: Straw-smoked u-dae galbi beef short rib, about 40,000-70,000 won pp.

items.title: Samwon Garden (삼원가든)
items.memo: Marinated and plain beef galbi; reservations advised for dinner.

items.title: Daechi Jeongyuk Sikdang (대치정육식당)
items.memo: Butcher-shop style beef inside ribs and pork cheek; few side dishes.

items.title: Hanok Grace (한옥그레이스)
items.memo: Pork and Korean beef platters served in a hanok; closed Sundays.
